test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Kathasaritasagara, a collection of stories, was written in which of the following languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanskrit.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Composed in** Sanskrit**, it showcases the literary richness of the language.
 
• It is written by **Somadeva in the 11th century CE**.
 
• A compilation of diverse stories, many derived from the **Baital Pachisi and Panchatantra.**
 
• Features a **frame story format**, where tales are narrated within a central narrative.
 
• Reflects the **social and moral values** of ancient India, influencing later literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pali**

 
 
• Language of the **Theravada Buddhist **scriptures.
 
• Tipitaka (Pali Canon), which includes the** Vinaya Pitaka, Sutta Pitaka, and Abhidhamma Pitaka.**
 
 
 
• **Prakrit**
 
 
• A group of Middle** Indo-Aryan languages.**
 
• Mahabharata (some versions), **Jain Agamas, and Svapna Vasavadatta.**
 
 
 
• **Persian**
 
 
• Language of the **medieval Islamic empire.**
 
• **Shahnameh by Ferdowsi, Rubaiyat by Omar Khayyam, and Khosrow and Shirin by Nezami**.
